args.message:
I added up order amounts and return amounts separately for each region, matching each order or return to its customer's region. I calculated the two totals separately because joining orders and returns together first would double-count amounts.

| Region | Total ordered | Total returned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| North | 109334.75999999994 | 2740.620000000001 |
| South | 104269.89999999994 | 3698.9599999999996 |
| East | 68738.69999999997 | 2418.45 |
| West | 49151.790000000015 | 1054.47 |
| null | 1193.3 | 25.0 |

The null row covers 16 orders and 2 returns whose customer is unknown or has no region.
